column1: # Every deviation from the EVA Admin 2019 release, declared.
#   MODIFIED    a release file whose content differs from manifest/originals.sha
#   DELETED     a release file that is no longer present
#   ADDED       a file that is not part of the release
#   GENERATED   an added file produced by a tool, regenerable, not hand-edited
#   ADDED_TREE  a directory of our own scaffolding; every file under it counts as
#               ADDED. Rejected if it overlaps any release path, so it can never
#               be used to hide an edit to EVA Admin source.
# MILESTONE is M0 (setup), M1..M4, or the milestone the change belongs to.
# REASON must say why, not what. "Fixed web.xml" is not a reason.
# Verified by tools/manifest-check.sh, which runs as a pre-commit hook.

column4: Repo owner recorded which modules are missing from the release, before this control system existed. Baseline for this file is therefore the untouched 2017 import.
2019-2020 notes from the first attempt to build and deploy: docker commands tried and the errors they produced. Kept as evidence, superseded by tools/ and docs/findings/.
WildFly 17 image built during that first attempt.
Deployment script from that first attempt; copies the built WARs into WildFly.
The release shipped without one. Keeps build output and bulky reference material out of the manifest check.
Operating instructions for AI agents working this repo.
The control that makes in-place changes traceable: baseline definition, generated checksums, and this declaration file.
Dockerised build toolchain, manifest and docs checks, git hook. Nothing here touches EVA Admin source.
Status, decisions, findings, work queue, specs and reference index.
PostgreSQL on the coordinates the release expects, for M2 onwards.

PostgreSQL DDL derived from the release's 120 @Entity classes by tools/schema-export. Regenerate with tools/schema-export/generate.sh; never hand-edit. The release ships no schema and the Flyway migrations were withheld (NF-007).

Released as a single comment line with no root element, so WildFly fails the deployment at PARSE with "Unexpected EOF in prolog". Replaced by an empty web-app 3.1 shell: this WAR holds EJBs and no servlets of its own. Same shell that made the backend start on origin/attempt. NF-004.

The runtime persistence unit the release does not ship; all nine of its persistence.xml files are test-scoped. Without it: "Can't find a persistence unit named 'evotePU'". Unit name and java:/jdbc/evote both recovered from the release source, entity list derived from the 120 @Entity classes. Regenerate with tools/generate-persistence-xml.sh. NF-006.

WildFly exposes only javax.persistence to a deployment, but EVA Admin's repositories use org.hibernate.Session and org.hibernate.jdbc.Work directly, so Weld refused to define the entire repository layer as beans. Adds the org.hibernate module dependency. NF-017.

Log4jUtil.configureFromClasspathConfig looks up log4j.xml on the classpath and throws "Unable to find log4j.xml on classpath" without it, taking down Log4jConfigurator. Copied verbatim from the release's own admin-backend test resources. NF-018.
Referenced by the DOCTYPE of the log4j.xml above; copied from the same place in the release. NF-018.

CommitIdProducer reads /version.properties at startup and throws without it. Not invented: admin-backend/pom.xml runs git-commit-id-plugin and filters src/main/resources, so the release had this file and it was stripped. Uses the plugin's own ${git.commit.id}. NF-018.
